reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, so one sachet I can toss in my gym bag actually fits how I live. The named lab and the batch report take care of my 'is it really tested' worry, and $24.99 is an easy impulse buy off a video.
objection: Is it really tested, or just marketing? I would want to open that lab report and see it is a real lab and a real batch before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be generic, missing, or not for the actual batch, I would skip it.
